mechanism: Piroxicam inhibits renal prostaglandin synthesis, reducing potassium excretion and increasing serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those on ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid concurrent use in patients with renal disease, hyperkalemia, or those on RAAS inhibitors; consider alternative NSAIDs or potassium supplementation adjustment.
